affinity.notes: Entirely grounded physical presentation with no elemental dependency.

anatomy.notes: Natural human proportions and pose are cleanly readable.

archetype.notes: Melee skirmisher does not communicate the intended reactive mirror-error duty.

counterplay.notes: The poised stance suggests agility, but no visible weapon or explicit attack cue clarifies engagement range.

finish.notes: Restrained monochrome finish suits the grounded design.

framing.notes: Unobstructed full-body framing supports instant recognition.

identity.notes: Human duelist or assassin does not reveal the mapped Doppelganger Mimic identity.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T2, not exact intended tier T3.
